input.body: We are writing to request a review of the $14.25 deduction on order DD-51123 on 2026-11-05, which was applied with the reason "missing item" for Veg Momo (Fried). The order ticket for DD-51123 lists 'Veg Momo (Fried)', so the item was on the order as it was prepared [DD-51123:ticket_lists_item]. We note that the ticket shows the item was ordered and does not by itself show what was in the bag. The order was ready at 18:36 and was picked up at 18:40, four minutes later, so the handoff to the courier took place after the order was ready [DD-51123:pickup_handoff]. Based on these records, we ask that the deduction be reviewed and, if the records support it, reversed. Thank you for your time and consideration.
